final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS fielding_count FROM fielding f LEFT JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT batting_hand, fielding_count, AVG(fielding_count) OVER () AS avg_count, SUM(fielding_count) OVER () AS total_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT COALESCE(batting_hand, '(missing)') AS batting_hand, fielding_count, 1.0 * fielding_count / total_count AS share_of_total, fielding_count - avg_count AS above_average FROM totals WHERE fielding_count > avg_count ORDER BY batting_hand
